theorem entropy_chain_rule (proved): H(X,Y) = H(Y) + H(X|Y) — log splitting + marginal telescoping

entropy_chain_rule proved: split log p(x,y) = log(p(x,y)/p_Y(y)) + log(p_Y(y)), telescoping sum gives marginal entropy
